findings.body: The diff calls `completion_cost` and `unpriced` but neither function is defined in the file or imported. The diff assumes these are present in the surrounding module, but I could not verify this by searching the repository. If they are missing or have different signatures than assumed, the tests will not compile or will test the wrong thing.
findings.title: Verify completion_cost and unpriced are defined

value.summary: Adds new model price entries and test coverage for cost calculations. The code looks sound, but I could not verify the existence or correct signature of `completion_cost` and `unpriced` functions, which are essential for correctness.
